name: AuroraRibbons
description: Translucent aurora curtains drawn as SVG bands whose edges follow layered sine waves, flowing continuously over a starry night sky with adjustable intensity, blur and tilt.
a11yNotes: The star field, glow and SVG ribbons are aria-hidden (the SVG is focusable=false) with pointer-events: none. The requestAnimationFrame loop runs only while visible and speed > 0; prefers-reduced-motion shows a static frame with no star twinkle.

propsApi.name: blur
propsApi.description: Blur applied to the ribbons in px.

propsApi.name: angle
propsApi.description: Tilt of the ribbon field in degrees.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
